column1: Everything down here is composed of very hard rock. Everything has a slimey look and feel due to the humidity.
column2: 這一帶全是硬梆梆的岩石，濕氣重到摸起來又滑又黏。

column1: Nothing can be climbed here. Things are either too slimey or too steep.
column2: 這裡沒東西能爬，不是太滑就是太陡了。

column1: You are dead! You can only restore, restart, or quit the game.
column2: 你死了！現在只能讀取存檔、重新開始，或離開遊戲。

column1: Well, %s1, that was a smooth half-gainer into the elevator shaft.  Did you decide that you would think more clearly with your brains re-organized?
column2: 哎呀，%s1，你這一跳漂亮地翻進了電梯井裡。是覺得把腦袋重新洗牌一下，會讓你想得更清楚嗎？

column1: That concludes your experiment involving the effects of total vacuum on the human body, %s1.
column2: 好啦，%s1，你這下總算親身做完「人體暴露在真空中會怎樣」這個實驗了。

column1: As you lie on the floor in a smoldering, carbogelatinous heap you can't help but wonder why you bothered getting up this morning.
column2: 你倒在地上，變成一堆還冒著煙的焦黑軟泥，忍不住在想，今天早上到底幹嘛還爬起床。

column1: You are now lying on the floor in many pieces.  Guess those beams meant business, %s1.
column2: 你現在躺在地上，被拆成好幾塊了。看來那些雷射光束不是鬧著玩的，%s1。
